blurb: Cedar Lake Golf Club features an 18-hole public golf course with five sets of tees, rolling fairways lined with cedar trees, two lakes, and granite outcroppings. The front nine is more open, while the back nine includes three par 5s and a signature par 4 with a granite mountain. The club offers memberships, golf lessons, a practice facility, and hosts corporate and charity outings.
extraNote: Groups may bring their own food and beverages for outings; catering options available · Weekday tournament rates from as low as $30 per player
